registered: 2026-09-21, before any small-signal run at the operating points of the frozen phase-based inputs
grouping: the frozen v1.0 rule without change, s1_cluster.group_table: 19 design columns plus the AC loading; 601-point complex responses of F to P, Q, V and f, two bands of equal weight, one scale per output; K-means per MV section, random_state 20260919, n_init 20, Lloyd; build inputs only; the build inputs are the three <S>_phase_build inputs and the responses are those of F at THEIR operating points
main_comparison: param_fixed against resp_fixed at the same K; the per-scenario memberships are the control
primary_tasks: the tasks whose power varies in the frozen inputs, kind train or tune. The online-serving task is constant in the window and excites nothing; its errors are reported beside the primary ones.
band_error: per task and output: RMS of the complex difference over a band divided by the RMS of the response of F over the same band, 0.1 to 3 Hz and above 3 to 20 Hz, on the 601-point grid; s1_summarize.ss_pair

pass_rule.rule: the smallest tested K whose worst primary-task band error of the PCC active power, above 3 to 20 Hz, is at most the limit at the build AND at the test input of the scenario
pass_rule.basis: the comparison scale of this project; not a grid code

peak_metrics.gain: refined peak gain of the equivalent divided by the refined peak gain of F, minus one; task to PCC active power
peak_metrics.frequency: refined peak frequency of the equivalent minus that of F, Hz
peak_metrics.phase: argument of G_E / G_F at the grid frequency where |G_F| is largest, degrees; the gain ratio at that same frequency is reported beside it

modes: clusters of coincident eigenvalues with the spectral projector of each cluster, s1_smallsignal; per task the dominant cluster of F and the dominant cluster of the equivalent are both reported, no sorted matching
positive_control: K = 12, one chain per hall: normalized difference of the hall responses to F below 1e-6 on the whole grid at every one of the six inputs

offpeak_control.definition: model at the mean operating point of the input; the power of the task is its window mean plus one sinusoid, allocated to the halls by the allocation column of the task; amplitude sqrt(2) times the standard deviation of the task power over the window, so the sinusoid has the RMS of the task fluctuation; applied through the in-device oscillators, no sampled profile
offpeak_control.frequency: the highest grid frequency f* such that the gain of F from the task to the PCC active power stays within 2% of its value at 0.1 Hz at EVERY grid frequency up to f*
offpeak_control.fixed_from: the saved response of F alone, before any equivalent is built

never: no grouping, K, weight, task set or input is changed after an error has been seen; no ranking of the two feature sets and no sign of the peak error is assumed
